primitives.label: Routines
primitives.tagline: Scheduled, recurring, monitored, or later work.
primitives.summary: Use this for anything that creates, schedules, monitors, reminds, posts later, repeats, keeps work updated, or otherwise runs in the future.
productFeatures: Future, recurring, monitored, scheduled, or background work.
Routine planning and saved routine notes.
Best-effort setup only when explicitly allowed and exactly specified.
userControls: What the routine should do.
The cadence, trigger, or condition.
The destination, such as web, Slack channel, or Slack thread.

primitives.label: Slack
primitives.tagline: Slack reading, posting, setup, reconnect, and install flows.
primitives.summary: Use this for Slack channel access, posting, thread behavior, app setup, permissions, reconnects, and install or uninstall guidance.
productFeatures: Slack OAuth connection and reconnect flows.
Slack channel and thread reads when Runneth has access.
Slack posting into supported channels and threads.
userControls: Which Slack channels Runneth is invited to.
Whether the request targets a channel root or thread.
When to reconnect Slack through Runneth.

primitives.label: Notion
primitives.summary: Use this for Notion connection, permissions, page or database access, reading, querying, and Notion-specific failures.
productFeatures: Native Notion access through Runneth.
Notion page and database reads when connected and authorized.
Notion-specific query and access behavior.
userControls: Which Notion workspace or pages are connected.
Which pages and databases Runneth can access.
When to reconnect or adjust Notion permissions.

primitives.label: Google Drive
primitives.tagline: Google Drive and Google file access.
primitives.summary: Use this for Drive connection, Google file access, Docs, Sheets, Slides, file selection, permissions, and Drive-specific read or write issues.
productFeatures: Native Google Drive access through Runneth.
Google file reads and writes where supported.
Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive file permission handling.
userControls: Which Google files are selected or shared.
Which Drive account is connected.
When to reconnect or grant access to specific files.

primitives.label: Web
primitives.tagline: Runneth web app surfaces, widgets, and setup UI.
primitives.summary: Use this for the Runneth web app, setup widgets, generated apps, openable pages, web chat, and web-only UI issues.
productFeatures: Runneth web chat and web setup flows.
Widgets and generated/openable app pages.
Web-only rendering or interaction surfaces.
userControls: Which web page or app they are using.
Which widget or setup flow they are trying.
Whether the issue happens in web, Slack, or both.

primitives.label: Data access
primitives.tagline: Motion data, external endpoints, and CLI-backed data access.
primitives.summary: Use this for Motion data pulls, external endpoints, CLI-backed reads, non-native integrations, and data-specific failures.
productFeatures: Motion CLI-backed data reads.
External endpoint and API access.
Long-tail or non-native integration data flows.
userControls: Which workspace, account, or date range to use.
Which connected data source or endpoint is relevant.
How narrow or broad the requested pull should be.

primitives.label: General
primitives.tagline: Broad Runneth behavior when no narrower primitive fits.
primitives.summary: Use this for platform-wide, model-provider, conversation, migration, cutover, or broad Runneth behavior that is not specific to one primitive.
productFeatures: Broad Runneth behavior across surfaces.
Conversation-level or model-provider incidents.
Cutovers, migrations, and platform-wide guidance.
userControls: Which conversation, workspace, or surface they are using.
Whether the issue is broad or tied to a narrower primitive.
Any exact error or provider request id they can share.
